text:
For a European resort development, the operator/brand longlist typically spans the following groups. Exact chain-scale classifications vary by market and data provider, so some “lifestyle” and collection brands can sit between luxury and upper-upscale.

## 1. Ultra-luxury and trophy-resort brands

Usually considered for exceptional beachfront, island, alpine, wellness, golf, or mixed-use residential sites:

- **Four Seasons**
- **Aman**
- **Rosewood**
- **Mandarin Oriental**
- **One&Only**
- **Six Senses**
- **Raffles**
- **Bulgari Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Ritz-Carlton**
- **St. Regis**
- **Regent**
- **Belmond**
- **Kempinski**
- **Auberge Resorts Collection**

These brands are generally highly selective and favor outstanding locations, relatively high development budgets, strong suite/villa components, and—frequently—branded residences. Aman, One&Only, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood and Kempinski are actively associated with resort, residential or European growth strategies. ([rosewoodhotelgroup.com](https://www.rosewoodhotelgroup.com/?utm_source=openai))

## 2. Global luxury brands with broader development applicability

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, The Luxury Collection, EDITION, W Hotels, JW Marriott, Bulgari |
| **Hilton** | Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR Hotels & Resorts |
| **Hyatt** | Park Hyatt, Alila, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, The Unbound Collection by Hyatt |
| **Accor / Ennismore** | Raffles, Fairmont, Sofitel Legend, Sofitel, Emblems Collection, MGallery, Orient Express, Delano, SLS, SO/, Mondrian |
| **IHG** | Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton, Vignette Collection |
| **Minor Hotels** | Anantara, Tivoli, Minor Reserve Collection |
| **Meliá** | Gran Meliá, The Meliá Collection, ME by Meliá, Paradisus by Meliá |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | Radisson Collection |

Marriott explicitly positions its luxury brands separately from its full-service and collection brands; Hyatt similarly classifies brands such as Alila as luxury and Andaz across luxury/upper-upscale. IHG’s European luxury-and-lifestyle portfolio comprises Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton, Vignette Collection and Hotel Indigo. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai))

## 3. Upper-upscale, premium and lifestyle brands

These are often more feasible for larger resorts, conversion projects, family-oriented properties, conference resorts and destinations with somewhat lower achievable rates.

| Hotel group | Relevant brands |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | Autograph Collection, Westin, Le Méridien, Renaissance, Sheraton, Tribute Portfolio |
| **Hilton** | Curio Collection, Canopy, Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Tapestry Collection in selected cases |
| **Hyatt** | Grand Hyatt, Destination by Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, The Unbound Collection |
| **Accor** | Pullman, Swissôtel, Mövenpick, MGallery |
| **IHG** | Hotel Indigo, voco, Crowne Plaza |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | Radisson Blu, art’otel, Park Plaza, Radisson Individuals |
| **Minor Hotels** | NH Collection, Avani, nhow |
| **Meliá** | Meliá Hotels & Resorts, ZEL, INNSiDE by Meliá |
| **Barceló Hotel Group** | Barceló Hotels & Resorts; Royal Hideaway at the luxury end |

**Radisson Blu is especially relevant to European resort studies:** Radisson describes it as Europe’s largest upper-upscale brand and has an established resort footprint across the continent. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai))

Collection brands—such as Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, LXR, Curio, Unbound, Vignette, MGallery, Radisson Collection and NH Collection—are particularly useful where the developer wants to preserve a property’s architecture, name or local identity while gaining access to a global distribution and loyalty platform. Marriott, Hilton and IHG specifically promote their collection brands as conversion- and independent-hotel-friendly propositions. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai))

## 4. Beachfront and all-inclusive resort specialists

For Mediterranean, Canary Islands, Balearic Islands, Greek islands, Turkish Riviera and similar leisure markets, the longlist often also includes:

- **JOIA by Iberostar** — luxury
- **Iberostar Selection** — premium
- **Paradisus by Meliá**
- **Meliá Hotels & Resorts**
- **Royal Hideaway**
- **Barceló Hotels & Resorts**
- **Club Med Exclusive Collection**
- **RIU Palace**
- **TUI Blue**
- **Robinson**
- **Ikos Resorts**
- **Sani Resort**

Iberostar’s current resort segmentation places JOIA as its luxury collection and Iberostar Selection as its premium family-and-couples offering. Iberostar Beachfront Resorts also participates in IHG’s platform under a strategic alliance, although Iberostar retains its ownership and autonomy. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/iberostar-beachfront-resorts?utm_source=openai))

## Practical initial longlist

For a typical upscale European resort feasibility study, a manageable first-round list might be:

**Luxury:**  
Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Luxury Collection, Six Senses, Regent, Fairmont, Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, Park Hyatt, Anantara, Kempinski, Gran Meliá, Meliá Collection and Radisson Collection.

**Upper-upscale/lifestyle:**  
Autograph Collection, Westin, Curio Collection, Unbound Collection, MGallery, Hotel Indigo, voco, Radisson Blu, NH Collection, Meliá and Barceló.

**Specialist beach/all-inclusive:**  
Paradisus, JOIA by Iberostar, Iberostar Selection, Ikos, Club Med and selected Barceló or TUI concepts.

The shortlist should ultimately be filtered by **site type, achievable ADR, number of keys, seasonality, access, conference demand, wellness/golf facilities, all-inclusive strategy, branded residences, required capex and preferred contract structure**—management agreement, franchise, lease or joint venture. A 70-key alpine resort with residences will attract a very different field from a 400-key Mediterranean all-inclusive resort.
